recovery.note: two full offline/online cycles were performed on the same agent-owned interval schedules; every scheduled slot exists exactly once locally and exactly once on the Hub, and the offline uploads carry byte-identical stdout

post_outage_executions_continue.note: after the link came back both schedules fired again (positive control), while no old slot was replayed

agent_owned_executions_have_no_realtime_.note: agent-owned scheduled executions exist on the Hub only after the Agent uploads them, so realtime LOG_CHUNK frames for them are dropped by the Hub (AppendLog requires an existing execution row); their logs are carried authoritatively by the final upload
